name: Vita Launcher
description: An application that allows to launch other installed apps, roms from emulators and PSP games and homebrews thbrough Adrenaline.
long_description: An application that allows to launch other installed apps, roms from emulators and PSP games and homebrews thbrough Adrenaline. This removes the bubbles limit of Livearea and allows to categorize applications.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
